shots.p: wide shot of a man in white robes standing on a high mountain at dawn, raising his hands in glorification toward the vast clear sky, clouds below
aerial view of perfectly balanced creation: a symmetrical seashell, a butterfly, a leaf with fine veins, arranged in natural light, harmony and precision
wide shot of migrating birds flying in perfect formation over a river valley at sunrise, each creature guided to its path
wide shot of lush green pasture spreading across hills after rain, sheep grazing, fresh morning light
wide shot of the same pasture turned dry, dark and withered, scattered dry stalks carried by the wind under a grey sky
medium shot of a young boy in a white robe reciting from memory with closed eyes in a quiet mosque courtyard, soft morning light
contrast shot of a lit window at night in a quiet village beside deep shadows, open and hidden, all known, wide shot under a starry sky
wide shot of a smooth easy path winding gently through green hills at sunrise, open and welcoming
medium shot of an old teacher in a robe gently speaking to a small attentive circle of listeners under a palm tree, warm afternoon light
close-up on the face of a humble man listening with tearful reverent eyes, soft light, heart moved by a reminder
medium shot of a man turning his back and walking away from a gathering of listeners, cold evening shadows stretching behind him
wide shot of a huge roaring wildfire on a far mountainside at night, intense orange glow, no people, overwhelming heat
close-up on the face of a man in torment and distress, sweat and sorrow, dark red background glow, despair without relief, non-graphic
medium shot of a man washing his face and hands for ablution at a clear stream at dawn, purity and calm
wide shot of a row of men praying together in a simple mosque, bowed in prostration, soft golden light through the windows
medium shot of a crowd of people in a glittering market eagerly holding gold, jewelry and goods, distracted by worldly shine
wide shot of an eternal-looking calm green garden with flowing river at golden hour beside a crumbling old sand palace fading away, lasting versus fleeting
close-up of ancient rolled scrolls tied with cord resting on a wooden shelf in soft lamplight, dust in the air, no visible writing
wide shot of ancient scrolls sealed in a clay jar in a desert cave lit by a beam of daylight, timeless wisdom, no writing visible
